subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: Should the trusted dashboard preview widget land as a bundled dashboard builtin after the linked phase-1 PR is fixed, or wait for a broader dashboard/browser-preview security decision?
rationale: The request crosses a trusted browser/process boundary and the only implementation candidate is still open with stack, proof, and security blockers, so automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Review Phase 1 First
options.body: Proceed with the linked read-only embed/reload/viewport PR after its blockers are fixed, while keeping dev-server and browser-inspection powers behind separate approval.

options.title: Wait For Broader Design
options.body: Pause preview-widget landing until maintainers settle the dashboard/browser-preview security model across page pixels, console/network data, screenshots, and process ownership.

options.title: Fold Into Browser Preview Track
options.body: Make a broader browser-preview tracker own this feature if maintainers want one trust-model discussion instead of a dashboard-specific builtin issue.

recommendation.title: Review Phase 1 First
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked read-only embed/reload/viewport PR after its blockers are fixed, while keeping dev-server and browser-inspection powers behind separate approval.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main plugin-tab/sandbox provenance and prior browser-preview product/security routing signal.
